capabilities.title: Cycle accuracy
capabilities.boundary: Firestorm/Icestorm pipeline, cache, speculation and per-instruction silicon timing are exploratory and unimplemented. Functional architectural results, observable timer behavior and causal event ordering remain mandatory.
capabilities.allowed_research: P102 measures executed instructions and P344 reports host performance. Neither result establishes M1 cycle timing or native throughput; these functional/accounting tasks are not made optional by this exclusion.
capabilities.promotion_evidence: Any future timing claim needs a separately reviewed model, a declared core/workload subset, independently measured reference traces, reproducible experiments and explicit error bounds. Deterministic virtual time alone is insufficient.

capabilities.title: GPU graphics
capabilities.boundary: AGX graphics, GPU acceleration and macOS GUI operation are exploratory and unimplemented. The required Linux witness is headless and uses the Apple serial console.
capabilities.allowed_research: WS20 permits source study, discovery/MMIO prototypes, no-op submissions, shader subsets, fence tests and an independent framebuffer. These bounded experiments do not establish functional AGX rendering or a macOS GUI.
capabilities.promotion_evidence: Any future graphics claim needs an explicit command/firmware/shader/display subset, original workloads, independent expected images or compute results, synchronization and fault tests, provenance and recorded unsupported operations.

capabilities.title: Unmodified macOS
capabilities.boundary: Unmodified macOS boot, Apple physical boot-chain compatibility, SEP services, GUI and general applications are exploratory and unimplemented. G4 direct-loaded Linux establishes none of these results.
capabilities.allowed_research: WS21 permits feasibility study and separately justified kernel experiments. Kernel entry, completed boot, user space, GUI and applications require separate witnesses; VMApple represents a different platform from J274/T8103.
capabilities.promotion_evidence: Any future macOS claim needs reviewed input provenance and applicable test permissions, exact host/model/guest artifacts, a reproducible workload and documented boot, security and device assumptions. The P315 go/no-go decision cannot block v0.1.
